attributes.board_name: New Jersey State Board of Dentistry

rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduates in the first year of the biennial period need 10 h incl. the 6 mandatory hours; graduates in the second year are exempt at the next renewal.
rules.alternatives: The Board may waive up to half of the hours for donated dental services to eligible persons (mandatory courses are never waived).
rules.audit_note: Keep proof of completion (and post-test proof for distance learning).

topics.who: Professional ethics and New Jersey law
Prescription opioid drugs incl. risks and signs of abuse, addiction and diversion
CPR, part of the mandatory hours

rules.notes: 6 mandatory hours incl. 3 h CPR. Online/recorded distance learning max 10 h and needs a post-test; live synchronous webinars count as in-person. Biennial period Jan 1, 2024 - Dec 31, 2025 per the Board notice.
